note: Hand-curated demo dictionary of common HK discharge medicines. info_* fields are label-style reference text only. They are NOT instructions and never tell anyone to start, stop, add or reduce anything.

drugs.info_zh: 撲熱息痛（Paracetamol）係常見嘅止痛退燒成分，好多唔同牌子嘅成藥都會含有。
drugs.info_en: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) is a common pain and fever ingredient found in many brands.

drugs.info_zh: Amlodipine 屬於鈣通道類別嘅降血壓成分，資料上常見於血壓相關嘅藥物。
drugs.info_en: Amlodipine is a calcium-channel blocker commonly listed for blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Aspirin（阿士匹靈）低劑量常見於薄血相關資料，高劑量常見於止痛資料。
drugs.info_en: Aspirin appears in antiplatelet reference info at low dose and pain reference info at higher dose.

drugs.info_zh: Atorvastatin 屬於他汀類（statin）嘅降膽固醇成分。
drugs.info_en: Atorvastatin is a statin listed for cholesterol-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Metformin 係常見嘅降血糖成分，資料上多數同血糖管理有關。
drugs.info_en: Metformin is a common ingredient listed for blood-sugar related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Simvastatin 屬於他汀類嘅降膽固醇成分。
drugs.info_en: Simvastatin is a statin listed for cholesterol-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Rosuvastatin 屬於他汀類嘅降膽固醇成分。
drugs.info_en: Rosuvastatin is a statin listed for cholesterol-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Lisinopril 屬於 ACE 類別嘅降血壓成分。
drugs.info_en: Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor listed for blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Ramipril 屬於 ACE 類別嘅降血壓成分。
drugs.info_en: Ramipril is an ACE inhibitor listed for blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Losartan 屬於 ARB 類別嘅降血壓成分。
drugs.info_en: Losartan is an ARB listed for blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Candesartan 屬於 ARB 類別嘅降血壓成分。
drugs.info_en: Candesartan is an ARB listed for blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.classHint: 降血壓 / 心跳（乙型阻斷）
drugs.info_zh: Bisoprolol 屬於乙型阻斷（beta-blocker）類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Bisoprolol is a beta-blocker listed for heart and blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.classHint: 降血壓 / 心跳（乙型阻斷）
drugs.info_zh: Metoprolol 屬於乙型阻斷類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Metoprolol is a beta-blocker listed for heart and blood-pressure related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Hydrochlorothiazide 屬於利尿（去水）類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic listed in fluid-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Furosemide 屬於利尿（去水）類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Furosemide is a loop diuretic listed in fluid-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Spironolactone 屬於保鉀利尿類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Spironolactone is a potassium-sparing diuretic listed in fluid-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Warfarin 屬於抗凝（薄血）類別嘅成分，資料上通常需要定期驗血。
drugs.info_en: Warfarin is an anticoagulant listed in blood-thinning related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Clopidogrel 屬於抗血小板（薄血）類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet listed in blood-thinning related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Omeprazole 屬於質子泵抑制（PPI）類別，資料上同胃酸有關。
drugs.info_en: Omeprazole is a proton-pump inhibitor listed in stomach-acid related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Pantoprazole 屬於質子泵抑制（PPI）類別，資料上同胃酸有關。
drugs.info_en: Pantoprazole is a proton-pump inhibitor listed in stomach-acid related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Famotidine 屬於 H2 類別，資料上同胃酸有關。
drugs.info_en: Famotidine is an H2 blocker listed in stomach-acid related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Gliclazide 屬於磺胺尿素類別嘅降血糖成分。
drugs.info_en: Gliclazide is a sulfonylurea listed for blood-sugar related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Glimepiride 屬於磺胺尿素類別嘅降血糖成分。
drugs.info_en: Glimepiride is a sulfonylurea listed for blood-sugar related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Levothyroxine 係甲狀腺相關嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Levothyroxine is listed for thyroid-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Salbutamol 係氣管相關嘅吸入成分。
drugs.info_en: Salbutamol is listed for airway-related inhaler medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Ibuprofen 屬於非類固醇消炎（NSAID）類別嘅止痛成分。
drugs.info_en: Ibuprofen is an NSAID listed for pain-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Diclofenac 屬於非類固醇消炎（NSAID）類別嘅止痛成分。
drugs.info_en: Diclofenac is an NSAID listed for pain-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Amoxicillin 屬於青黴素類別嘅抗生素成分。
drugs.info_en: Amoxicillin is a penicillin-class antibiotic ingredient.

drugs.info_zh: Ciprofloxacin 屬於喹諾酮類別嘅抗生素成分。
drugs.info_en: Ciprofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic ingredient.

drugs.info_zh: Gabapentin 係神經相關嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Gabapentin is listed for nerve-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Allopurinol 係尿酸相關嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Allopurinol is listed for uric-acid related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Digoxin 係心臟相關嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Digoxin is listed for heart-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Sertraline 屬於 SSRI 類別嘅成分。
drugs.info_en: Sertraline is an SSRI listed for mood-related medicines.

drugs.info_zh: Pravastatin 屬於他汀類嘅降膽固醇成分。
drugs.info_en: Pravastatin is a statin listed for cholesterol-related medicines.
